assertions.description: 行驶中没有阻断时端点不列这条旅程
检查点等待挂上后端点列出车、站、阻断码与开始时间，开始时间就是库里记下的那一个
assertions.actual: AGV-L2-001 / N1-3_N1-7 / VEHICLE_WAITING_AT_CHECKPOINT since 2026-10-09T16:12:37.2229289+00:00 (0 s, Operator, AwaitingPickupArrival @ N1-3_N1-7)

assertions.description: 码被清掉后端点不再列出这条旅程，库里阻断码与开始时间一并清空
会话未就绪挂上后端点带开始时间与会话的原因码、安全原因码、SafetyUnknownPresent，安全证据不全直接最高档
assertions.expected: ONBOARD_SESSION_NOT_READY with since, session reason, ["IO_FACT_UNKNOWN"], unknown=True, MaintenanceAdministrator
assertions.actual: ONBOARD_SESSION_NOT_READY since 2026-10-09T16:12:38.7046234+00:00 (0 s, MaintenanceAdministrator, AwaitingPickupArrival @ N1-3_N1-7); session {"present":true,"reasonCode":"DEPARTURE_SAFETY_NOT_READY","safetyReasonCodesJson":"[\"IO_FACT_UNKNOWN\"]","safetyUnknownPresent":true}

assertions.description: 这一行被后续写入（同码、UpdatedAt 前移）之后，端点与库里的开始时间都不变，已挂时长照实增长
看板的旅程阻断卡片渲染出这条阻断：车、取货站、阻断码、安全原因码，按维护管理员那一档上色
assertions.actual: escalation-maintenance-administrator AGV-L2-001  N1-3_N1-7  ONBOARD_SESSION_NOT_READY  2026-10-10 00:12:38  0 分 3 秒  维护管理员  原因码 DEPARTURE_SAFETY_NOT_READY；安全原因码 ["IO_FACT_UNKNOWN"]；安全证据有未知项：是  L2-SUBLOT-20261009T161211403Z|WIRE_TO_GATE：待装

assertions.description: 到站换段之后会话未就绪那条阻断已清掉，端点不再列出这条旅程
仓门未闭告警挂上后端点列出 AwaitingLoadResult（不是 Blocked）、取货站与开始时间，开始时间就是库里记下的那一个，按操作员档
assertions.actual: (not listed) → STATION_TIMEOUT_DOOR_NOT_CLOSED since 2026-10-09T16:13:13.7272191+00:00 (0 s, Operator, AwaitingLoadResult @ N1-3_N1-7)

assertions.description: 告警挂着期间运行时又跑了几轮，码与开始时间不变，stage 仍是 AwaitingLoadResult
assertions.actual: STATION_TIMEOUT_DOOR_NOT_CLOSED since 2026-10-09T16:13:13.7272191+00:00 (4 s, Operator, AwaitingLoadResult @ N1-3_N1-7)

assertions.description: 门关上后端点不再列出这条旅程，库里阻断码与开始时间一并清空，本站仍在等装货结果

assertions.actual: LOAD_RESULT_REQUIRES_RECOVERY since 2026-10-09T16:13:19.7285515+00:00 (0 s, Operator, Blocked @ N1-3_N1-7)

assertions.description: 停摆期间运行时又跑了几轮，阻断码与开始时间不变
